description: This file declares the Messenger class, which implements a plugin for messaging and room management within the WPEFramework. It includes methods for joining/leaving rooms, sending messages, handling notifications, and integrating with JSON-RPC. It also defines nested classes for notification and callback handling related to room events and user activity.

classes.name: Messenger
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing messaging, room management, and notification handling within the WPEFramework.

classes.name: MsgNotification
classes.description: Handles message notifications within a room, forwarding messages to the Messenger instance.

classes.name: Callback
classes.description: Handles user join/leave callbacks within a room, forwarding events to the Messenger instance.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Private nested class for remote connection notifications (conditional on USE_THUNDER_R4).

methods.name: JoinRoom
methods.description: Joins a specified room with a given user name.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a specified room.

methods.name: Created
methods.description: Handles creation of a room notification.

methods.name: Destroyed
methods.description: Handles destruction of a room notification.
